svg.title: Wirehair 1 versus Wirehair 2 through K=64000
svg.desc: Four panels show lifecycle milliseconds and exact-K and eventual recovery rates for 64-byte and 1280-byte blocks. K is sampled every 1000 from 1000 through 64000, with the original small K points included. Recovery uses 16 paired IID loss trials at ten percent loss and a K+4 horizon. Lower lifecycle time is better; higher exact-K rate is better.
svg.text: Top: no-loss lifecycle time · bottom: exact-K and eventual recovery at 10% IID loss
Source: checked-in CSV snapshots · current benchmark build · diagnostic, not universal qualification
